steps.title: Welcome to XTRACER
steps.body: This guided tour walks through workspace setup, rendering, editor workflows, logs, and settings.

steps.title: Create a Workspace
steps.body: Enter a name and click '+' to create a workspace. A scene picker dialog will appear to bind a scene and variant.

steps.title: Active Scene
steps.body: This card shows the scene, camera, and variant bound to the active workspace.

steps.title: Choose Camera
steps.body: Select the render camera used for the next render job.

steps.title: Open Render
steps.body: Move to Render to configure integrator, quality, tone mapping, and export.

steps.title: Select Integrator
steps.body: Choose the rendering algorithm here. Different integrators trade speed, noise, and lighting accuracy.

steps.title: Sampling Quality
steps.body: Samples and anti-aliasing heavily affect quality and render time. Start low for previews, increase for finals.

steps.title: Tone Mapping
steps.body: Tone mapping controls how high-dynamic-range lighting is mapped to display output.

steps.title: Export Format
steps.body: Choose the preview-toolbar export format. PNG/JPG are convenient; EXR/HDR preserve more data.

steps.title: Start Rendering
steps.body: In Render, adjust quality controls in the sidebar, then click Render to run a job.

steps.title: Save Render
steps.body: After a render finishes, choose a format and use the save button in the preview toolbar to download the output.

steps.title: Open Editor
steps.body: Switch to Editor to work on scene content in 3D, graph, or text mode.

steps.title: 3D View Mode
steps.body: Use 3D View to inspect geometry and interact with scene objects visually.

steps.title: Graph Mode
steps.body: Graph mode shows scene structure and relationships for quick validation.

steps.title: Text Editor Mode
steps.body: Text Editor gives precise control over the scene source.

steps.title: Edit Scene Source
steps.body: In Text Editor mode, edit scene source directly and use New Scene for a fresh template.

steps.title: Save Your Scene
steps.body: Use Save to persist changes. Load Selected Scene refreshes editor content from disk.

steps.title: Open Logs
steps.body: Logs show backend events and warnings while you work and render.

steps.title: Log Filters
steps.body: Filter log levels to focus on warnings/errors or include debug details when troubleshooting.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Settings controls theme, UI behavior, and runtime polling preferences.

steps.title: Theme and Palette
steps.body: Adjust theme and palette to match your environment and readability preferences.

steps.title: Reset Tutorial Later
steps.body: In Settings, use this toggle to replay tutorial on next launch, or Start Tutorial Now.
